description: Error returned when a query against an aggregate-only source requests row results but references a quasi-identifier column in a way that would expose it as more than a count. The row results are withheld to protect individual-level data. To obtain the aggregate-only response (the gated total count and obscured facet statistics), re-run the query without requesting row results.

rowSuppressionReasonCode.description: The machine-readable code for why the row results were withheld.
